{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Create a classic photography forum event website using Next.js, inspired by clean GitHub-style layouts and old-school community forum pages. This is a static front-end only website, no backend, no login, no database, no API calls, no real comments system. Use mock/static/sample content for everything.

Project Name: LensCircle Annual Photo Walk & Forum Day 2026

Website Type: Static event-site + photography community forum landing page

Main Goal:
Build a polished but classic website for a photography community event where visitors can read the event details, browse forum-style discussion previews, see speakers/mentors, view workshop schedule, check photo contest categories, and register interest through a fake/static CTA button. It should look like a serious photography forum/community website, not a modern SaaS dashboard.

Tech Requirement:
- Use Next.js
- Static pages/components only
- Responsive design for desktop, tablet, mobile
- No external API
- No authentication
- No database
- No backend routes
- No real form submission required
- All data can be hardcoded in arrays/components

Design Style:
Classic web forum + GitHub reference feeling:
- White / light gray background
- Thin borders
- Boxed content sections
- Subtle blue links
- Compact forum rows
- Header similar to a classic open-source project/community page
- Typography should be clean and readable
- Avoid overly futuristic glassmorphism
- Avoid neon style
- Avoid 3D, canvas, WebGL, animations that feel game-like

Sticky Navigation:
Add a sticky top navigation bar that remains visible when scrolling.
Navigation links:
- Overview
- Forum Topics
- Schedule
- Mentors
- Contest
- Gallery
- Venue
- FAQ

Header / Hero Section:
Left side:
Small badge: Community Photography Event • Since 2014
Main headline: LensCircle Annual Photo Walk & Forum Day 2026
Subheadline: A classic community gathering for street, wildlife, portrait, and documentary photographers to learn, discuss, critique, and shoot together.
CTA buttons:
- View Schedule
- Browse Forum Topics
- Submit Photo Entry (static button only)

Right side:
Create a classic forum info card, not a photo upload app.
Card should include:
- Event Date: 18 October 2026
- Location: Riverside Arts Hall + Old Market District
- Members Attending: 428
- Forum Threads: 96
- Photo Critique Slots: 64
- Status: Registration Interest Open

Trust / Stats Bar:
Below hero add compact stats:
- 12 Years Running
- 40+ Community Mentors
- 900+ Photo Walk Alumni
- 8 Workshop Tracks
- 120 Featured Prints

Forum Preview Section:
Create a section that looks like a classic forum index table/list.
Title: Community Forum Discussions
Columns or row layout should show:
- Topic title
- Category tag
- Replies
- Last post
- Small status label

Sample forum topics:
1. Best lenses to bring for the Old Market evening walk
Category: Gear Talk
Replies: 34
Last Post: 2 hours ago by Maya R.
Status: Active

2. Street photography etiquette during crowded events
Category: Field Practice
Replies: 51
Last Post: Today by Omar K.
Status: Hot

3. How to prepare prints for the community wall
Category: Print Lab
Replies: 18
Last Post: Yesterday by Claire D.
Status: Open

4. Wildlife photography mini-session checklist
Category: Nature Track
Replies: 22
Last Post: Jun 28 by Niko S.
Status: Updated

5. Beginner critique thread: post one image, get feedback
Category: Critique Corner
Replies: 67
Last Post: Jun 27 by Admin Team
Status: Pinned

Schedule Section:
Classic timeline/table style, not flashy.
Include day schedule:
- 08:30 AM Check-in and community breakfast
- 09:15 AM Opening talk: Photography as local memory
- 10:00 AM Parallel workshop sessions
- 11:30 AM Forum roundtable: Gear, ethics, editing habits
- 01:00 PM Lunch break and print wall viewing
- 02:00 PM Guided photo walks by track
- 04:30 PM Live critique circle
- 06:00 PM Photo contest shortlist reveal
- 07:00 PM Closing remarks and community meetup

Workshop Tracks:
Add cards or rows for:
- Street Photography Basics
- Documentary Storytelling
- Portraits in Available Light
- Wildlife in Urban Parks
- Editing Workflow Review
- Print Preparation Clinic
Each card needs a short description, difficulty level, and mentor name.

Mentors Section:
Create mentor profile cards with static placeholder images or CSS photo boxes.
Mentors:
- Elena Morris — Documentary Photographer
- Jamal Pierce — Street Photography Mentor
- Priya Nair — Portrait & Natural Light Coach
- Tomas Reed — Wildlife Photographer
- Mei Alvarez — Photo Editor & Print Specialist
- Daniel Cho — Community Critique Moderator
Each card should include: specialty, years experience, one-line quote.

Photo Contest Section:
Title: 2026 Community Photo Contest
Classic category list:
- Street Moment
- Urban Wildlife
- Human Portrait
- Night & Low Light
- Black and White Story
- Beginner Favorite
Include rules as static text:
- One image per category
- JPEG only mentioned visually, no upload needed
- Photos must be taken during the event weekend
- Judging based on story, composition, and originality
Add a static CTA button: View Submission Guidelines

Gallery Preview:
Use a static grid of sample photography cards. No real image fetching needed. Use local placeholders, gradients, or simple image boxes.
Cards should have captions:
- Morning light on 5th Street
- Portrait under station arches
- Reflections after rain
- Market vendor at closing hour
- Heron near the river path
- Community print wall 2025
Make it feel like an editorial photography archive.

Venue Section:
Two-column layout:
Left: Venue details
- Riverside Arts Hall
- 24 East Harbor Road
- Main forum hall, print room, critique tables, courtyard meetup point
Right: Static information box
- Nearest train: Old Market Station
- Parking: North Lot B
- Accessibility: Step-free entrance available
- Bring: Camera, spare battery, memory card, water bottle, comfortable shoes
Do not embed a real map. Use a static map placeholder box.

FAQ Section:
Accordion styling is okay, but it can be static or simple front-end only.
Questions:
- Do I need to be a professional photographer?
- Can beginners join the critique circle?
- Is the event free?
- What camera gear should I bring?
- Can I attend only the forum sessions?
- Are images uploaded on this website?
Answers should clarify this is an informational static website and any buttons are demo/static.

Footer:
Classic community footer with columns:
- LensCircle
- Event
- Forum Links
- Community Guidelines
- Contact placeholder
Add copyright: © 2026 LensCircle Community Forum

Extra UI Details:
- Add sticky nav with active-looking hover states
- Add breadcrumbs near top: Home / Events / Annual Photo Walk 2026
- Add GitHub-like labels such as Pinned, Active, Updated, Mentor Track, Beginner Friendly
- Use clean cards with borders and small shadows
- Include small icons if available from simple CSS/text, but no external icon service required
- Make sections visually dense but organized, like a complex event forum page
- Use mock content only
- Ensure mobile view stacks tables into readable cards

Deliverable:
A complete static Next.js website/page with reusable components and classic responsive styling. The final result should feel like a realistic photography community event site combined with a forum index, with sticky navigation and detailed static content.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
